title: Document that a site or prober column with neither value nor range prints empty cells
findings_note: Obfuscator/TestResultsGenerator.cs fixed-column value fallback prints empty cells; README.md and Obfuscator/PackageReadme.md are silent.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Follow-up from ob-28. A site or prober column configured with neither `value` nor `range` prints empty, padded cells, and the docs don't say so. Targeted to v0.2.0.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: README.md and Obfuscator/PackageReadme.md, where they describe test-results device columns; Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs only if no test pins the behaviour yet.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - If no existing test pins it: a site column and a prober column with neither `value` nor `range` print cells that hold only spaces, padded to the column width, on every device row.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: In README.md, where the test-results device columns are described, state that a site or prober column with neither `value` nor `range` prints empty, padded cells. Add the same point to PackageReadme.md's test-results line, keeping it short. Change no code.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Run `dotnet test Obfuscator.slnx` and `dotnet format Obfuscator.slnx --verify-no-changes`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Docs, plus a test if one is missing.
